construct: ABCB11 encodes the bile salt export pump (BSEP), an ATP-binding cassette transporter on the canalicular membrane of hepatocytes that mediates biliary bile-acid export. BSEP deficiency causes PFIC2 with cholestasis and typically low or normal GGT.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Infantile progressive cholestasis with severe pruritus, low GGT, and biallelic ABCB11 variants identifies BSEP deficiency/PFIC2; ABCB11 mediates ATP-dependent canalicular bile-salt export.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: NTCP is basolateral uptake, MRP2 exports conjugated bilirubin, MDR3/ABCB4 exports phosphatidylcholine and is linked to PFIC3, and basolateral bile-acid efflux is not BSEP's normal canalicular function.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The gene, membrane domain, substrate, and GGT phenotype all align on BSEP; no competing transporter is defensible.
